newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: ZIMBABWE URGES CLOSER TRADE TIES WITH MOZAMBIQUE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE URGES CLOSER TRADE TIES WITH MOZAMBIQUE.

text.p: Zimbabwe's Deputy Industry and Commerce Minister Obert Mpofu on Friday urged Mozambique to sign a bilateral agreement to increase trade between them.
Mpofu, who led a large business delegation to Mozambique this week, also urged more regular contact between business.
Zimbabwean and Mozambican companies were importing products from Europe or Asia instead of supporting local brands, he said, adding: "We must do something to overcome this situation."

The minister said he had visited Maputo harbour on Thursday where he was surprised to find 1,000 car kits from Korea awaiting export to Botswana where they would be assembled and exported to Zimbabwe.

"This is an absurd deal which brings no advantage to any of the three countries involved," said Mpofu, adding that it would be better to assemble the vehicles in Mozambique and then export them to other countries in southern Africa.
Mpofu's Mozambican counterpart, Abilio Bichinho, said he expected a bilateral agreement to be drawn up by a Mozambique-Zimbabwe Joint Cooperation Commission.
The business mission to Mozambique was organised by the Zimbabwe Trade Association which has invited Mozambican businessmen to visit Zimbabwe.
